Validator Name: Hazen Network Solutions

Hazen Network Solutions operates validators and full nodes across multiple networks, collaborating with DePIN, AI, and LLM projects.

Networks Currently Validating:
Testnet: 0G Labs, Limonata, Airchains, AtomOne, Gensyn, Gnoland, Mantra Chain, Odiseo, Pell Network, Lumera, Monad, Safrochain, Story Protocol, Tacchain, Tellor, Titan Network, Warden Protocol, XRPL EVM, Zenrock.
Mainnet: AtomOne, Espresso, Flock IO, Gnoland, Humanode, Tangle Network, Tellor, XRPL EVM, Zenrock.

Digital Presence:
Website: https://www.hazennetworksolutions.com/ | Twitter: https://x.com/haznftofficial | GitHub: https://github.com/hazennetworksolutions
Contact: haznftofficial@gmail.com | Telegram: https://t.me/haznft | Discord: hazentr

Why We're Interested:
As an AtomOne mainnet validator, we are interested in gno.land's ecosystem and IBC/Interchain Security. We participated in public Gnoland networks from Test6 through Test13, then Topaz, Sapphire, and Pearl, and support the project long-term.

Contributions:
We operate a Gnoland mainnet full node and tx-indexer with a public explorer: https://explorer.hazennetworksolutions.com/gnoland-mainnet/
It covers blocks, transactions, accounts, consensus, packages/realms, events, validators, and snapshots. Node and validator guide: https://guides.hazennetworksolutions.com/gnoland/
